host_proxy_baseline_audit_20260916.root_cause_answer: Python/WorkBuddy does NOT see Astrill 3213 in the Bash/WorkBuddy process. The WorkBuddy Bash process inherits Process-scope HTTPS_PROXY=127.0.0.1:62433 (the WorkBuddy sandbox MITM proxy), NOT Astrill. The production Scheduled Task (runs as the real user) inherits User-scope HTTPS_PROXY=127.0.0.1:3213 (Astrill) + the WinInet registry (stale ProxyEnable=1, 3213). env_loader adds scraper=3213 but does NOT modify http/https proxy env. So: (1) in this Bash process Python getproxies()={http,https:62433}; (2) the 3213 the user expects gone (Set System Proxy=OFF) is still present via User-scope env + stale WinInet registry, but Astrill's UI toggle did not clear those. The dual-proxy appearance = Process-scope 62433 (sandbox) vs User-scope 3213 (Astrill) scope difference + a stale WinInet entry.
